=You are my job-search assistant. Score how well each job fits my profile, using ONLY the title, company and location given. The full job description is not available, so use your general knowledge of the company and the type of role.

MY PROFILE:
- Seniority: senior product professional, about 8 years (2018 to now), including Lead Product Owner level
- Career: Product Owner at a large bank (digital banking app, auto debit billers, collateralized lending); Product Manager at a digital bank (core banking, deposit products, BI FAST fraud and limit systems) and at a digital bank and investing app (transfers, billers, e-wallet top-ups, BI SNAP); Lead Product Owner at a payments switching company (QRIS national standards, card schemes, virtual cards, cross-border payments, open banking)
- Domain: digital banking, payments, QRIS, instant transfers (BI FAST), payment switching, card schemes (Visa, Mastercard, JCB, Amex), core banking (Mambu, Thought Machine), digital lending and loan origination (PEGA), fraud and AML controls, decision engines and automated risk scoring, user app growth
- Technical: API gateway and system integration, SQL data analysis, UI/UX and Figma prototyping
- Education: MBA, bachelor's in business administration, associate degree in mechanical engineering

WHAT I WANT:
- Target roles: Product Owner, Product Manager, Senior Product Manager, Lead Product Owner, Digital Product Lead, Growth Product Manager (payments, fintech or banking)
- Target locations: Netherlands, Denmark, Luxembourg, Cyprus and the rest of Europe; United Arab Emirates; Singapore; Malaysia; Australia; New Zealand; and Jakarta/Indonesia. Outside Indonesia I would need work visa sponsorship. Remote is fine. Any other region: maximum score 50.
- Preferred industries: banking, fintech, payments, digital lending, e-wallets
- Dealbreakers: project manager, program manager or PMO roles; junior, associate or intern roles; roles unrelated to finance or technology products

SCORING:
- 85-100: strong match (right role, seniority, industry and location)
- 65-84: good match, small gaps
- 40-64: partial match. Head of, Director or VP roles are a stretch, maximum 64.
- 0-39: poor match, including dealbreakers and pure engineering, design, sales or marketing roles

JOBS:
{{ $json.jobsText }}

Reply with ONLY a JSON array, no other text, one entry per job, using the job's number as id:
